snippet.title: Puzzle to the Center of the Earth - Match 3 meets Spelunky
snippet.description:
Now available!

iOS: https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/puzzle-to-center-earth/id905462619?mt=8

Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.foursakenmedia.ptce

Puzzle to the Center of the Earth is a unique game that blends matching, platforming, puzzle, and exploration elements, coming to iOS/Android devices in early October!

In Puzzle to the Center of the Earth, players will drag to match 3 or more blocks to destroy them, creating a pathway for your character to journey through and freely explore the area. There are over 80 huge levels across a variety of different environments. Find hidden treasure and secret passages, avoid dangerous enemies and obstacles, solve intricate puzzles, and ultimately dig your way downwards to the core of the Earth!
